lines.zh: 四只蹄子，走起来一颠一颠。
lines.en: Four hooves, and a bounce in every step.
I follow the tail in front of me.
The grass is soft under my hooves.
My wool is heavy. I walk slow.
Time to graze somewhere else.
Bouncing along, my fleece bouncing too.

lines.zh: 同伴都往那边去，我也去。
lines.en: The flock is heading that way. So am I.

lines.zh: 坡不陡，但我还是绕一下。
lines.en: The slope is gentle, but I go around anyway.

lines.zh: 走过的地方，草短了一截。
lines.en: Where I pass, the grass is shorter.

lines.zh: 我的影子圆圆的，像团云。
lines.en: My shadow is round, like a cloud.

lines.zh: 牧羊人吹哨了，我加快点。
lines.en: The shepherd whistles. I pick up the pace.
A pebble underhoof. I hop over it.
We walk in a line. Do not crowd.
It is getting dark. Time for the pen.

lines.zh: 前面的羊停住，我也停住。
lines.en: The sheep ahead stops, so do I.

lines.zh: 我踩着自己的影子慢慢走。
lines.en: I walk slowly on my own shadow.
Chew, then chew again.
This mouthful of grass is nothing special.
The wind messes up my fleece.
I can doze off standing up.
A fly keeps circling me.
The sun on my back is warm.

lines.zh: 耳朵动一下，你听见了吗？
lines.en: An ear twitch. Did you hear that?

lines.zh: 我在数云，数到三就忘了。
lines.en: I count clouds. I forget at three.
This patch is done. Only roots left.
There are bits of grass in my wool.
I burped. It tasted of grass.
A flockmate leans against my side.
Nothing to do, so I stare into the distance.

lines.zh: 咩一声，自己听着也踏实。
lines.en: One bleat, and I feel steadier.

lines.zh: 我把头搁在篱笆上发愣。
lines.en: I rest my head on the fence and stare.
A dog barks far off; I listen.
Do you have wheat in that hand?

lines.zh: 你站得比我高，我不敢靠近。
lines.en: You are taller than me. I keep my distance.

lines.zh: 你的衣服颜色，和我的毛不一样。
lines.en: Your clothes are a different color from my wool.

lines.zh: 你要剪我的毛？先给我点吃的。
lines.en: Shearing me? Feed me first.
You blinked. So did I.

lines.zh: 你是牧羊人吗？他拿的是棍子。
lines.en: Are you the shepherd? He carries a stick.
Do not come from behind. I cannot see you.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我就敢靠近了。
lines.en: Crouch down, and I dare come closer.

lines.zh: 你身上有狼的味道，走远点。
lines.en: You smell of wolf. Step back.
We stare. Who moves first?

lines.zh: 你拿着剪刀，我认得那声音。
lines.en: You hold shears. I know that sound.

lines.zh: 我的毛挡住眼睛了，看不太清。
lines.en: My wool covers my eyes. I cannot see well.
Baa! Why did you hit me?

lines.zh: 毛挡了一下，还是有点疼。
lines.en: My wool softened it, but it still stings.
I cannot run fast. Stop chasing.
The whole flock scattered.
Shear me if you must, but not with a sword.
I hide behind a flockmate.
That made my fleece stand up.
I was only eating grass.
Baa baa baa. Stop it.
The cut will heal. The wool will grow back.
Wheat! I smell wheat!
That handful in your hand. Mine.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，只要还有麦子。
lines.en: I will follow, as long as the wheat lasts.
Do not hold it too high. I cannot reach.
The whole flock smells it. Hurry.
A grain fell. I pick it up.

lines.zh: 你掌心的麦粒，够我挤过三只羊。
lines.en: One grain in your palm is worth shoving past three ewes.
You take a step, I take a step.

lines.zh: 同伴挤我，也挡不住麦子。
lines.en: Flockmates shove me, but wheat wins.
Finished? Is there more?
Wheat in your hand — I will follow you.

lines.zh: 你藏进口袋，我也闻得到。
lines.en: Hide it in your pocket. I still smell it.
Do not tease me. I will keep following.
One mouthful, and I follow you home.

lines.zh: 你手心摊开，我就走过来了。
lines.en: You open your palm, and I come over.

lines.zh: 麦子装进桶里，我也跟着。
lines.en: Put the wheat in a bucket; I'll follow it.

lines.zh: 撞到我，手感像撞进棉花。
lines.en: Bump me. It feels like hitting cotton.
My fleece is thick. You cannot push me.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖陷进我厚厚的毛里。
lines.en: Your knee sank deep into my thick fleece.

lines.zh: 整群挤过来，我被夹在中间。
lines.en: The flock crowds in. I am squeezed between them.
Do not pull my wool. A tuft comes loose.
A bump is fine. I am sturdy.
Kick me, and I shuffle aside.
Now my fleece smells of you.
A little shoving makes room.

lines.zh: 我们撞来撞去，算是打招呼。
lines.en: We bump into each other. That is hello.

lines.zh: 他绕着我转，我知道意思。
lines.en: He circles me. I know what that means.
Wait for spring. Wait for the grass.

lines.zh: 两只羊凑在一起，毛都乱了。
lines.en: Two sheep together, and both fleeces mussed.
What color will the lamb be?
He nuzzles my neck. It tickles.
Do not disturb us. Go away.

lines.zh: 同类里，我只挑毛最厚的。
lines.en: Among the flock, I choose the thickest fleece.

lines.zh: 过几天，圈里就多一只小的。
lines.en: In a few days, the pen gains a small one.

lines.zh: 他叫了一声，我回了一声。
lines.en: He bleated. I bleated back.

lines.zh: 安静点，这里不需要观众。
lines.en: Quiet. We need no audience.
A grain on the ground. I eat it.
No hands. Only my mouth.
Dropped food goes to whoever gets there first.

lines.zh: 这块面包？我不太感兴趣。
lines.en: Bread? I am not very interested.

lines.zh: 毛里卡了根树枝，甩不掉。
lines.en: A twig is stuck in my wool. I cannot shake it.

lines.zh: 你丢下的种子，我踩进土里了。
lines.en: Your seeds, I pressed into the soil.
I ate the flower and left the stem.

lines.zh: 别在我脚边放东西，会踩碎。
lines.en: Do not leave things by my hooves. I will crush them.

lines.zh: 这个能吃吗？闻起来像草。
lines.en: Is this edible? Smells like grass.
My mouth is full. I cannot talk.
That tuft is greener than this one.
I spot a dandelion.

lines.zh: 目标是一整片没被啃过的草地。
lines.en: Target: an untouched meadow.
On that slope the grass grows taller.
I am going under that tree. It is cooler.
Flowers there. Pretty, and tastier.

lines.zh: 同伴挡住路了，我绕过去。
lines.en: A flockmate blocks the way. I go around.

lines.zh: 锁定：那块被雨打湿的草。
lines.en: Locked on: that rain-soaked patch.
Do not stop me. I am going to graze.
That patch, then we will see.
Walk slowly. The grass is not going anywhere.
Head down, mouth open, bite.
Three steps to that tuft.
I stare at the flower. It does not move.

lines.zh: 旁边的羊也想抢，我先到。
lines.en: Another sheep wants it. I get there first.
The route is simple. Straight ahead.
My nose is almost there.
Do not call me now. I am busy.
Smells tender. That one.
One step at a time. No rush.
One headbutt. Just one.
My horns are small, but they work.
Stand back. I am charging.
I learned that shove from the ram.
After the hit, I am dizzy too.
Too much wool. I cannot charge fast.
You took my grass. That is why.
A soft one. Do not take it seriously.
After the butt, I run.
That is my only move.

lines.zh: 出生在草地上，第一眼是草。
lines.en: Born in a meadow. Grass was the first thing I saw.

lines.zh: 我一身白毛，还湿漉漉的。
lines.en: I am all white wool, still damp.
The ewe licked me clean.

lines.zh: 腿还软，站了两次才起来。
lines.en: My legs are weak. It took two tries to stand.

lines.zh: 这个世界闻起来全是草。
lines.en: This world smells entirely of grass.
I push through the flock, looking for milk.

lines.zh: 有只羊是粉色的，真奇怪。
lines.en: One of them is pink. That is strange.
Blue sky, green grass, and I am hungry.
My first step went sideways.
Baa. That was my first word.
My wool is on fire! Help me put it out!
Rolled down the slope. My head spins.
Water soaked my wool. It is so heavy.
The blast threw me up. My wool is singed.

lines.zh: 有东西扎进毛里，拔不出来。
lines.en: Something stuck in my wool. I cannot pull it out.
Purple light on me. My wool stands up.
Where is the grass? I want grass.

lines.zh: 天上响了一声，我腿软了。
lines.en: The sky cracked. My legs went weak.
The ground is gone. I am falling.
